# Plans and pricing

## Purpose and scope

This document sets out the public list prices, seat rules, plan limits and service levels for Quillon's contract-management software. It covers the four subscription plans offered to law firms and corporate finance teams: Starter, Team, Pro and Enterprise. It is effective from 2026-07-01 and applies to all new subscriptions and to renewals on or after that date. Written by the pricing team.

Quillon's software supports drafting from templates, a clause library, approval workflows, e-signature, obligation tracking, renewal alerts and search across signed contracts. Every plan includes these features. The plans differ in seat limits, storage, e-signature volume and support response times.

## Pricing overview

All prices are listed per seat per month and are shown in US dollars (USD) and euros (EUR). Monthly billing applies when a subscription is billed each month. Annual billing applies when a subscription is paid once per year for the full term, and the per-seat rate is lower under annual billing. All prices exclude tax. Applicable value added tax, sales tax or other taxes are added at invoice time according to the customer's location.

The table below is the reference for all plan values. Each row is one plan.

| Plan | Plan code | USD per seat per month (monthly billing) | USD per seat per month (annual billing) | EUR per seat per month (monthly billing) | EUR per seat per month (annual billing) | Seat minimum | Standard seat cap | Storage per account | E-signature envelopes per month per account | First support response |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | PLN-STR-10 | $19 | $16 | EUR 18 | EUR 15 | 3 seats | 10 seats | 25 GB | 20 | 2 business days |
| Team | PLN-TEAM-25 | $29 | $25 | EUR 27 | EUR 23 | 5 seats | 25 seats | 100 GB | 100 | 1 business day |
| Pro | PLN-PRO-50 | $38 | $32 | EUR 35 | EUR 30 | 10 seats | 50 seats | 500 GB | 500 | 4 business hours |
| Enterprise | PLN-ENT-200 | $62 | $52 | EUR 57 | EUR 48 | 25 seats | 200 seats | 2 TB | 2,000 | 1 hour for severity 1 |

## Plan details

### Starter

The Starter plan suits small law practices and finance teams with a small number of contract users. It costs $19 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $16 per seat per month when billed annually. In euros, it costs EUR 18 per seat per month on monthly billing, or EUR 15 per seat per month when billed annually. The plan code is PLN-STR-10. The standard seat cap of the Starter plan (PLN-STR-10) is 10 seats, and the plan requires a minimum of 3 seats.

Each Starter account includes 25 GB of storage and 20 e-signature envelopes per month. First support response is within 2 business days.

### Team

The Team plan suits growing practices and mid-sized finance teams that need more seats and faster support. It costs $29 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $25 per seat per month when billed annually. In euros, it costs EUR 27 per seat per month on monthly billing, or EUR 23 per seat per month when billed annually. The plan code is PLN-TEAM-25. The standard seat cap of the Team plan (PLN-TEAM-25) is 25 seats, and the plan requires a minimum of 5 seats.

Each Team account includes 100 GB of storage and 100 e-signature envelopes per month. First support response is within 1 business day.

### Pro

The Pro plan suits larger firms and corporate finance functions with several contract teams. It costs $38 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $32 per seat per month when billed annually. In euros, it costs EUR 35 per seat per month on monthly billing, or EUR 30 per seat per month when billed annually. The plan code is PLN-PRO-50. The standard seat cap of the Pro plan (PLN-PRO-50) is 50 seats, and the plan requires a minimum of 10 seats.

Each Pro account includes 500 GB of storage and 500 e-signature envelopes per month. First support response is within 4 business hours.

### Enterprise

The Enterprise plan suits large firms and corporations with many users and high signing volumes. It costs $62 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $52 per seat per month when billed annually. In euros, it costs EUR 57 per seat per month on monthly billing, or EUR 48 per seat per month when billed annually. The plan code is PLN-ENT-200. The standard seat cap of the Enterprise plan (PLN-ENT-200) is 200 seats, and the plan requires a minimum of 25 seats.

Each Enterprise account includes 2 TB of storage and 2,000 e-signature envelopes per month. For severity 1 incidents, first support response is within 1 hour.

## Reading plan codes

Each plan code ends in a number that gives the standard seat cap of that plan. For example, the number at the end of PLN-TEAM-25 is 25, which matches the Team plan's standard seat cap of 25 seats. Customers and account managers can read the seat cap directly from the code.

## Seats and minimums

A seat is one named user with access to the platform. Each plan has a seat minimum, which is the smallest number of seats a customer can purchase on that plan. The standard seat cap is the number of seats the plan is designed for. Customers who need more seats than the standard seat cap should contact Quillon sales to discuss an arrangement that fits their needs.

Seat counts are set at the start of each billing period. Seats added during a billing period are charged for the remaining part of that period. Seats removed take effect at the next billing period.

## Storage and e-signature allowances

Storage allowances apply per account and cover all uploaded contracts, templates, clause library entries and attachments. E-signature allowances apply per account per month and count each envelope sent for signature. Unused envelopes do not carry over to the following month.

If an account reaches its storage or envelope allowance, Quillon notifies the account administrator. Customers may then reduce usage or move to a plan with higher allowances.

## Support response times

Support response times are measured from the time a support request is logged in the Quillon support system during business hours. The first response is an acknowledgement and an initial assessment, not a full resolution. The Starter plan gets a first support response within 2 business days. The Team plan gets a first support response within 1 business day. The Pro plan gets a first support response within 4 business hours. The Enterprise plan gets a first support response within 1 hour for severity 1 issues.

## Billing and taxes

Monthly billing charges each month in advance. Annual billing charges once per year in advance for the full term. Prices are fixed in the currency shown on the order form. All prices exclude tax, and applicable taxes are added to each invoice. Quillon does not change the price of an active subscription during its current term.

## Questions

Questions about these plans, seat rules or pricing should be directed to the Quillon sales team. Customers with specific needs for seat numbers, storage or support should discuss them with sales before signing an order form.

# Enterprise plan

## Overview

The Enterprise plan (PLN-ENT-200) is Quillon's contract-management offering for large organisations, including law firms with multiple practice groups and corporate finance teams managing high volumes of agreements. It brings together drafting from templates, a clause library, configurable approvals, electronic signature, obligation tracking, renewal alerts, and search across signed contracts in a single workspace. This document describes what the plan includes, how it is priced, and the conditions that apply to it. It takes effect on 2026-07-01.

## Pricing and billing

The Enterprise plan costs $62 per seat per month on monthly billing. When the subscription is billed annually, the Enterprise plan costs $52 per seat per month. Prices are stated in US dollars and exclude applicable taxes. Customers choose their billing frequency when they sign the order form, and the selected frequency applies for the full term of that order form.

## Minimum and maximum seat counts

The Enterprise plan requires a minimum of 25 seats. Organisations that need fewer seats should review the Professional plan instead. The standard seat cap of the Enterprise plan (PLN-ENT-200) is 200 seats. Any order above that cap needs a custom order form, which Quillon's sales team prepares after reviewing the organisation's deployment, security, and support requirements. Seat counts can be increased during a subscription term, and additional seats are prorated from the date they are added.

## Storage

The Enterprise plan includes 2 TB of storage per account. This allowance covers uploaded source documents, executed agreements, attachments, and audit records. Storage is pooled across all workspaces within the same account rather than allocated per user or per workspace. Customers who expect to exceed the allowance should raise the matter with their account team before their usage reaches the limit, so that options can be discussed in advance.

## Drafting, clause library, and approvals

Enterprise administrators can publish drafting templates to specific teams and lock approved clauses so that authors cannot alter them without going through a review step. Approval chains on the Enterprise plan can have up to 20 steps, which allows large organisations to model multi-level sign-off involving legal, finance, risk, and business owners. Approval routing can be conditional, so that a contract above a set value, or one containing a non-standard clause, follows a different path from a routine renewal. Every approval decision, comment, and change is recorded in the contract's history.

## Electronic signature and obligation tracking

Contracts can be sent for electronic signature directly from the workspace once approvals are complete. Signed agreements are stored in the same repository as drafts, with the executed version linked to the approval record that preceded it. Obligation tracking lets teams record deliverables, payment dates, reporting requirements, and notice periods extracted from each agreement, with named owners assigned to each item. Renewal alerts notify owners ahead of renewal and termination windows, and the lead time for these alerts can be configured by contract type.

## Search across signed contracts

Search covers the full text of signed agreements, their metadata, and their associated obligations. Users can filter by counterparty, governing law, value, date range, clause presence, and status. Results can be exported for reporting, and search permissions follow the same access controls as the underlying contracts, so that users see only the agreements they are authorised to view.

## Included services and support

Every Enterprise account gets a named customer success manager who coordinates onboarding, configuration, and ongoing reviews of how the platform is used. Support is available to Enterprise customers through the priority channel. The Enterprise plan gets a first support response within 1 hour for severity 1, which covers incidents where the platform is unavailable or a core workflow such as signature or approval routing has stopped for a substantial part of the organisation.

## Identity and security controls

SCIM provisioning is available on the Enterprise plan only. It allows the customer's identity provider to create, update, and deactivate user accounts automatically, which keeps access aligned with staff changes and removes the need for manual account maintenance. Customer-managed encryption keys are available on the Enterprise plan only. With this option, the customer controls the keys that protect its stored contract data, and can rotate or revoke them according to its own policies. Both features are configured during onboarding with the customer success manager and the customer's security team.

## Changes and renewal

Quillon may update the features included in the Enterprise plan from time to time, provided that changes do not materially reduce the functionality available during an active subscription term. Material changes are notified to customers in advance. At renewal, the seat count, billing frequency, and any custom terms are confirmed in writing before the new term begins.
